facts.text: You must register your vehicle in California to use it in the state.

cites.quote: You need to register your vehicle in California to use it in the state.

facts.text: When you buy a vehicle, you have 10 days to transfer ownership to your name.

cites.quote: When you buy a vehicle, you have 10 days to transfer ownership to your name.

facts.text: When you sell a vehicle, you must notify the DMV within five days by completing a Notice of Transfer and Release of Liability.

cites.quote: When you sell a vehicle, you must notify DMV within five days by completing a Notice of Transfer and Release of Liability

facts.text: You have 20 days to register an out-of-state vehicle after you become a California resident or get a job in California.

cites.quote: You have 20 days to register your vehicle after you become a resident or get a job in California.

facts.text: All vehicles registered in California must meet California requirements, including emission controls, and the DMV cannot register a vehicle that does not qualify.

cites.quote: All vehicles registered in California are required to meet California requirements including vehicle emission controls in support of California’s clean air standards. DMV cannot register a vehicle if it does not qualify.
